runs.name: corrected_selectors_and_import_return
runs.command: npx playwright test tests/e2e/real_data_context.spec.ts tests/e2e/sessions_imports.spec.ts tests/e2e/tenant_onboarding.spec.ts tests/e2e/tenant_onboarding_live.spec.ts tests/e2e/workday_import_return.spec.ts --reporter=list,json --output=.cache/ux-corrected-results

browser.full_run_failures: Six old UI selectors expected removed readiness/attention classes or visible chart/history content now behind explicit disclosures. Tests were adapted without removing business/security assertions. Full-run workers had already loaded the previous selectors.
browser.corrected_retry: 31/31 PASS: all six formerly failing cases plus existing related cases and five new confirmed/lost/unconfirmed CSV-return and branch-change cases. A new empty onboarding organization was created; main fixture accounts/data were preserved.
browser.explicit_full_run_skips: Two opt-in stock live scenarios require separate fresh databases; both were subsequently executed successfully.
coverage: nine CSV schemas, preview, validation and commit
explicit human approval, deficit acknowledgement, audit and export
correction, freshness and immutable approved exports
safe return after confirmed CSV receipt

focused_browser_runs.scope: Stock mobile table and explicit forecast date recheck

stock_live_scope: Counted opening, activated recipe, receipt, consumption, reversal, reconciliation, procurement evidence, approval and export on a fresh SYNTHETIC SQLite.
count_anchor_live_scope: Generated REAL/TEST CSV count correction, explicit acceptance of two count anchors, resumed receipts, worker calculation, human approval, audit, export and byte-identical older approved export on a fresh SQLite.

visual.general_capture_scope: Ten sections, KK/RU, desktop 1440 and mobile 390; no page overflow or browser errors in the test.

review: Independent agent read-only review of current UX and pending test adaptations: no actionable findings; business and security assertions retained.
